targets.name: neon-jaytibirthday-db
targets.notes: Postgres warehouse for analytics and telemetry (D-9). Project, branch and endpoint verified 2026-10-22 against the provider: project fancy-cloud-99501540 ('jaytibirthday-db'), branch br-spring-pine-au5jtfig ('main', primary), endpoint ep-long-credit-au7qr9gy, DATABASE jpbir_live. THE DATABASE NAME IS PART OF THE TARGET. The same project and endpoint also carry a second database, 'neondb', which is a COPY frozen at 2026-10-09T18:30Z - and the local .env.local and the repository's DATABASE_URL secret both pointed at that copy, which is why every local analysis of 'the warehouse' read as the product having stopped collecting. The local .env.local now points at jpbir_live; the DATABASE_URL secret still needs replacing, and it must name jpbir_live.

targets.name: jp-agent-render
targets.notes: The jp-agent runtime behind jaytipargal.tech, verified live 2026-10-19. Vercel reaches it through JP_AGENT_URL (Backend/agent-run.js). Deployed from git; render.yaml declares the service shape, and no deploy script, ssh path, systemd unit or nginx config exists in this repository. DNS: runner.jaytipargal.tech and jp-agent.onrender.com both resolve to gcp-us-west1-1.origin.onrender.com via Cloudflare, TLS CN=runner.jaytipargal.tech valid to 2027-01-17. GET /health -> 200 {ok:true,service:"jp-agent",mcp:"in-process"}; /sessions -> 401 without a bearer token. "mcp":"in-process" means the standalone s24-mcp server is not in use and the tools are served in-process from s24-tools.mjs.
